annotations.title: Get live Solana network health: epoch progress, validator counts, stake concentration and skip rate.

description: Get live Solana network health: epoch progress, validator counts, stake concentration and skip rate. Returns the current epoch and its progress, active and delinquent validator counts, total active stake in SOL, the delinquent stake share, the Nakamoto coefficient (fewest validators holding over a third of stake), median commission, cluster block production and skip rate so far this epoch, and median and best vote credits per SOL staked in the last complete epoch. Use it as the baseline when judging a single validator. Free, no payment needed. Source: Solana mainnet-beta (public chain state via JSON-RPC), Public on-chain data.
name: solana_validators_get_network_summary
